primary_objective: For every frozen lesion-size subgroup, absolute mean tumor-only Dice gap between the image-label-only WSL consumer and GT-trained reference must be <= 0.05.

consumer_invariants.preprocessing: RGB resize to 448x448 and ImageNet normalization
consumer_invariants.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation tumor-only Dice at fixed threshold 0.5; tie-break by normal empty-mask specificity within Dice tolerance 0.0001
consumer_invariants.threshold_selection: independently per arm on validation: maximize mean tumor-only Dice, then normal empty-prediction rate, then proximity to 0.5
consumer_invariants.evaluation_population: all 371 validation images; primary Dice means include all 184 tumors and every complete miss

only_allowed_training_difference.wsl_experimental: train pseudo-masks produced using radiographs and image-level labels only

prohibited_wsl_inputs: GT-derived lesion size, location, shape or crop
test images or annotations for model selection

statistics.subgroup_membership_usage: post-prediction diagnosis only; never used by inference or per-image routing

historical_wsl_baseline.effective_common_threshold_grid_note: The historical WSL sweep additionally evaluated 0.05/0.10/0.15/0.90, but selected 0.85; restricting both arms to the locked common 0.20-0.85 grid leaves both selected thresholds and every reported metric unchanged.
